groups.name: lang
groups.description: lang matches on the primary subtag, case-insensitive; unsupported or missing languages leave quotes, apostrophes, short words and numeric ranges untouched

cases.desc: en-US is English, with American quote nesting
uppercase EN is English
ru-RU is Russian
en-US gets the English short-word list
unsupported language leaves quotes
unsupported language leaves apostrophe
unsupported language gets no short-word nbsp
unsupported language still gets language-free rules
unsupported language gets no numeric range
missing lang gets no numeric range
unsupported language gets no em dash
missing lang gets no em dash
cases.input:
dog -- cat
dog - cat
- cat
dog — cat
cases.expected:
dog -- cat
dog - cat
- cat
dog — cat

cases.desc: missing lang leaves quotes
missing lang leaves apostrophe
empty lang leaves quotes
underscore tag is not matched
english-like word is not matched
object property name as lang does not throw
__proto__ as lang does not throw
unsupported language gets no ampersand nbsp
missing lang gets no ampersand nbsp

groups.name: russian
groups.description: Russian-specific rules: em-dash, non-breaking spaces after short words, guillemet quotes, numeric range

cases.desc: spaced hyphen becomes em-dash
nbsp after short preposition
outer guillemet quotes
nested quotes use lower-9 style
short conjunction followed by comma still glues to next word
numeric range after a short word (only this rule: with every rule on the short-word rule glues the preposition)
hyphen: short particle is glued
minus after an opening guillemet
dialogue dashes
typed em dash gets a no-break space
minus after a nested low-9 opening quote
particles that follow a word are not bound to the next word
cases.input: пошёл бы он ли там же тут
cases.expected: пошёл бы он ли там же тут

cases.desc: ни and ко bind to the next word
an ampersand between spaces binds the space after it

groups.name: english-regions
groups.description: en picks single outer quotes unless the first two-letter alphabetic subtag after the primary one (up to a singleton) is US or CA, which pick double outer quotes; case-insensitive; script, numeric region and private-use subtags do not count

cases.desc: en-US nests single inside double
en-CA nests single inside double
script subtag is skipped
region is case-insensitive
region before a variant or extension still counts
private use subtag is not a region
extension singleton stops the search
en-GB nests double inside single
numeric region is single
region on a non-English tag does not matter
an en-US opener is closed as en-US in an en segment
an en opener is closed as en in an en-US segment

groups.name: japanese
groups.description: ja is unsupported: language-dependent rules (quotes, apostrophes, short words, numeric range) stay off and language-free rules still apply. Pins the current state; these cases change on purpose when support lands

cases.desc: straight quotes are left as written
apostrophe is left as written
no short-word nbsp
numeric range is left as written
no em dash: double hyphen, hyphen, line-start hyphen and typed em dash are left as written
cases.input:
dog -- cat
dog - cat
- cat
dog — cat
cases.expected:
dog -- cat
dog - cat
- cat
dog — cat

cases.desc: hyphenated phone number is left as written
hyphen: Latin fragments are glued
hyphen: a hyphen next to Han or Kana is left as written
cases.input: 東京-大阪間 T-シャツ
cases.expected: 東京-大阪間 T-シャツ

cases.desc: minus after a straight quote: the quote stays, the minus is formatted
no ampersand nbsp

groups.name: korean
groups.description: ko gets typographic quotes only (double outer, single inner, like en-US); short-word nbsp, numeric range and the other language-dependent rules stay off, and language-free rules still apply. Pins the current state; these cases change on purpose when full support lands

cases.desc: double quotes become American-style double quotes
nested quotes alternate, double outer and single inner
single quotes around Hangul are quotes at the outer level, so they become double (documented)
ko-KR is Korean
apostrophe between Latin letters is converted
no short-word nbsp
numeric range is left as written
no em dash: double hyphen, hyphen, line-start hyphen and typed em dash are left as written
cases.input:
dog -- cat
dog - cat
- cat
dog — cat
cases.expected:
dog -- cat
dog - cat
- cat
dog — cat

cases.desc: hyphenated phone number is left as written
hyphen: Latin fragments are glued
hyphen: a hyphen next to Hangul is left as written
minus after an opening quote
no ampersand nbsp
